lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: メイちゃん、お邪魔します。
lines.en: Mei-chan, thank you for having me.
lines.style: Warm opening with a soft breath before speaking. Gentle, genuine respect threaded through—the kind of earnest courtesy that comes from caring. Steady pace, settling into comfort.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お義母さん、来てくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Mother-in-law, I'm so glad you came.
lines.style: Tender greeting, eyes brightening slightly on the opening. Unhurried, sincere—the kind of warmth that settles into the room. No performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひかり、大きく、なったね。
lines.en: Hikari's grown so much, hasn't she.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to herself. Genuine admiration in the voice. A small pause before the sentence—the noticing of time passing. Warm, gentle.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: She really does grow every single day.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Measured, thoughtful pacing. The slight catch of a mother watching time move—present but reflective. Soft and centered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 一緒に、お茶、飲みましょう。
lines.style: A warm invitation, the voice opening slightly. Unhurried, almost maternal in its gentleness. The kind of simplicity that holds deep comfort.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Yes, what a lovely time this is.
lines.style: Agreeing with genuine ease. Soft smile audible in the voice. Present and grounded—savoring the moment without needing to name it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Quiet reflection, almost wonderstruck. Slow pace, letting the words settle. A deep exhale of gratitude—simple, profound, the kind of thing said only when truly felt.
